name: tech.landmine/landmine
title: landmine
description: Known open GitHub issues in exact npm and PyPI versions, with workarounds, for coding agents.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Project directory with .landmine/index.json (default: the working directory). Create it with `npx landmines scan`.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token for landmine_lookup (no scopes needed). Without it, the GitHub CLI's login is used.
